Use this app for LRV and LCh°. LRV is Light Reflectance Value and LCh° is Lightness, Chroma, and Hue Angle which means you can download The Color Strategist color wheel and determine what hue family a color belongs to.

How It Works:

LRV Guru™ app can be USED ALONE to calculate known LRV value differences.

LRV and LCh° are displayed via the "Compare" option from the menu.

LRV Guru™ app MEASURES Light Reflectance Value (LRV) when integrated with Variable, Inc.'s Color Muse hand-held colorimeter. 

The spectral data captured with the Color Muse and the values and/or ratios ascertained using the LRV Guru app are reasonably informative guidelines - "in the ballpark", as they say.
 
Beyond reasonably informative guidelines would require certified measurements from a color lab.

NOTE: You cannot take a picture of a color with your smartphone or camera and ascertain LRV. A picture of a color is just a captured image, it is NOT A MEASUREMENT! To MEASURE LRV using this app, you must use a Color Muse or NODE+Chroma hand-held colorimeter.
